name: Cherry Mobile main-path baseline
purpose: Broad, shallow functional stability checks. No performance score or exhaustive parameter matrix.

resultStatuses.passed: The action and its expected visible outcome were observed, with evidence.
resultStatuses.problem: An established product failure was observed; preserve its evidence.
resultStatuses.incomplete: Not exercised, missing prerequisites, unavailable capability or unresolved attribution; never count as passed.

sharedRules: Resolve target, environment, device and dataset with the initiating user; only ask for missing choices.
Markdown runbooks remain exploratory drafts; executable scope and replay status are recorded in scripts metadata. Automated runs do not fall back to ad hoc agent UI actions.
Read each selected case's expected outcome before acting. Missing UI is not replaced silently with a different path.
Use only caller-approved data and model calls. Preserve dedicated data and restore reversible settings.
Record a separate result for every selected case/device pair, including incomplete cases.
A crash, hang or fatal UI error in any case must be retained; continue only independent checks.

dataRequirements.runContext: Caller-selected code target, existing environment, device and dataset; record identifiers, not secrets.
dataRequirements.chatAgent: A caller-approved in-app Agent with a usable text model.
dataRequirements.twoTextModels: Two caller-approved text models usable by the selected app.
dataRequirements.ownedChat: A conversation created for this run; keep a known message and distinguish it from existing user data.
dataRequirements.ownedAgent: An in-app Agent created for this run; retain its identity until dependent checks finish.
dataRequirements.attachmentImage: A caller-approved image available through the app or system picker.
dataRequirements.attachmentDocument: A caller-approved document and a model that supports its intended use.
dataRequirements.imageModel: A caller-approved image-generation model and allowance for the selected real generation calls.
dataRequirements.imageEditModel: A caller-approved model supporting reference-image editing.
dataRequirements.templatePhoto: A caller-approved reference photo when the selected template requires one.
dataRequirements.ownedBoard: A board created for this run with at least one successful image.
dataRequirements.ownedVersion: A disposable run-created image version; preserve another version for navigation.
dataRequirements.editableImage: A caller-approved static JPEG, PNG or WebP image; edits must preserve its original.
dataRequirements.testProvider: A dedicated provider configuration that the caller permits changing; retain its original values.
dataRequirements.modelDefinition: A valid model identifier and settings supplied by the caller for the test provider.
dataRequirements.profileImage: A caller-approved avatar image accessible to the selected device.
dataRequirements.reversiblePrivacyControl: A privacy control offered by this build that can be restored without submitting diagnostics.
dataRequirements.photoDestination: A caller-approved device-local save destination with the necessary existing permission.
dataRequirements.assistantFile: An existing caller-approved assistant-produced file, or one explicitly requested during this run.
dataRequirements.fileSamples: Caller-selected known-good files with recognizable content; use fixtures/README.md for requirements and optional bundled samples.

scripts.startingState: Disposable device with the development client installed and the workspace Metro running. Each test clears app data and completes onboarding against the local mock chat service.
scripts.sourceObservation: Written from the app source; no replay with the e2e runner yet.

cases.title: Open the selected app
steps: Open the caller-selected compatible app on the selected device and code target.
Wait for its ordinary starting screen.
cases.expected: The starting screen is usable without a fatal error, persistent blank screen or unexpected exit.

cases.title: Complete first-run setup
steps: Start from empty app data.
Connect a custom OpenAI-compatible service, enter its model ID and start chatting.
cases.expected: Setup completes after its connection check and opens a usable chat screen.

cases.title: Move between main modules
steps: Visit chat, drawings, the file library, in-app Agents and settings.
Return to chat.
cases.expected: Each destination opens and the final chat screen remains usable.

cases.title: Background and return
steps: During ordinary use, put the app in the background.
Return to the same app.
cases.expected: The app resumes into a usable state and the current content is accessible.

cases.title: Reopen recent chat after relaunch
steps: Fully close and reopen the selected app; reconnect to the same code target if needed.
Open the run-created recent conversation and send a short follow-up.
cases.expected: The prior messages are visible and the follow-up completes.

cases.title: Reopen recent board after relaunch
steps: After a full app relaunch, open the run-created recent board.
Open an existing image and return to its canvas.
cases.expected: The board and image remain accessible and navigation works.

cases.title: Send and follow up
steps: Create a run-labelled conversation with the selected in-app Agent.
Send a short harmless question, observe the reply, then ask a follow-up.
cases.expected: Both replies appear and the conversation remains usable.

cases.title: Stop an active answer
steps: Start an answer long enough to expose the stop control.
Use stop while that answer is active.
cases.expected: The selected answer stops and the composer becomes usable; a response that finished before stop was exercised is not a pass for this case.

cases.title: Retry an answer
steps: Use the normal retry/regenerate action on a run-created answer.
Observe the new answer.
cases.expected: A new answer is produced and the conversation can continue.

cases.title: Select a model through @
steps: Type @ in the composer and inspect the offered model entry.
Select an approved model through that entry and send a short question.
cases.expected: The @ selection is accepted and a reply associated with that model appears; an ordinary model picker does not substitute for this path.

cases.title: Request two model answers
steps: Select two approved models using the app's multiple-model flow.
Send one question, inspect both answers, then continue from a chosen answer.
cases.expected: Both answers are accessible and continuation from the selected answer works.

cases.title: Switch answer branches
steps: Use run-created alternative answers, generating an alternative only when needed.
Switch between the answers and continue from one selected branch.
cases.expected: Alternatives remain accessible and the new turn follows the selected branch.

cases.title: Fork into a new conversation
steps: Use the offered fork/new-conversation action on a run-created message.
Enter the new conversation and send a follow-up.
cases.expected: A distinct conversation opens with the expected context and accepts the follow-up.

cases.title: Delete a message or turn
steps: Choose a run-created message/turn and use the offered delete action.
Confirm that item is gone and continue using the conversation.
cases.expected: The selected content is removed while the remaining conversation stays usable.

cases.title: Delete a conversation
steps: After dependent checks, delete a run-created disposable conversation.
Return to the conversation list.
cases.expected: The conversation is absent from the list and another conversation can still be opened.

cases.title: Switch conversations
steps: Open another caller-approved or run-created conversation.
Return to the run-created recent conversation.
cases.expected: The selected conversation's messages are shown each time.

cases.title: Find a known message
steps: Search for a distinctive phrase sent during this run.
Open its result, inspect the matching conversation, then return to its latest messages.
cases.expected: The known message can be located and normal conversation navigation resumes.

cases.title: Preview a draft attachment
steps: Attach a caller-approved image or document to a draft.
Open its preview and return to the draft.
cases.expected: Recognizable content opens and the draft remains available.

cases.title: Remove a draft attachment
steps: Remove a selected draft attachment using its composer control.
Inspect the remaining draft.
cases.expected: The selected attachment is removed without deleting the source library file or losing unrelated draft content.

cases.title: Send a retained attachment
steps: Attach a caller-approved document supported by the chosen model.
Send a short question about it and observe the answer.
cases.expected: The submitted attachment remains accessible with the message and an answer appears.

cases.title: Create a test Agent
steps: Create an in-app Agent with a run-specific name and an approved model.
Return to the Agent list.
cases.expected: The new Agent appears and can be opened.

cases.title: Edit the test Agent
steps: Change the run-created Agent's name and approved model.
Save, leave and reopen its settings.
cases.expected: Both selected values are visible after reopening.

cases.title: Chat with the test Agent
steps: Open the run-created Agent and start a conversation.
Send a short question.
cases.expected: The conversation uses that Agent and receives a reply.

cases.title: Delete the test Agent
steps: After its dependent checks, delete only the run-created Agent.
Return to the Agent list.
cases.expected: That Agent is absent and the list remains usable.

cases.title: Create a board through generation
steps: Enter Drawings and send a simple prompt using the approved image model.
Wait for the new board and generated image.
cases.expected: The first generation creates a board and a readable image appears.

cases.title: Browse and filter templates
steps: Open the template stage.
Switch templates, select an available category and dismiss the stage.
cases.expected: The visible template/category changes and the gallery remains usable.

cases.title: Generate from a template
steps: Choose a template and use it.
Complete its fields and provide the approved photo if required, then generate.
cases.expected: The resulting board opens with a readable generated image.
cases.condition: If the selected template needs a photo, resolve templatePhoto with the caller before sending.

cases.title: Navigate the board canvas
steps: Pan and zoom a run-created board canvas.
Select a node and return to the overview framing.
cases.expected: The canvas responds and its nodes remain accessible.

cases.title: Open a board image
steps: Open a selected image from the canvas.
Inspect it in focus and return to the canvas.
cases.expected: The image is readable and the board remains navigable.

cases.title: Edit a reference image with AI
steps: Select a run-created generated image as the reference.
Request one simple change and open the resulting version.
cases.expected: A new readable version appears and its source image remains accessible.

cases.title: Edit using an image note
steps: In image focus, add a positional note and enter a simple edit instruction.
Generate and open the result.
cases.expected: The note/instruction can be submitted and a new readable result appears; aesthetic precision is not scored.

cases.title: Select the generation model
steps: Open generation settings and choose an approved compatible image model.
Generate a simple image and inspect its generation information.
cases.expected: Generation completes and the recorded model matches the selection.

cases.title: Change the generation ratio
steps: Choose one ratio supported by the approved model.
Generate once using that selection.
cases.expected: The selected ratio is retained in the generation information and a readable image appears.
cases.condition: Use an available ratio control; do not invent a control for a model that does not expose one.

cases.title: Change the image count
steps: Choose a supported image count within the caller's allowance.
Generate once and inspect the returned images.
cases.expected: The selected count is retained and the expected number of readable images is accessible.
cases.condition: Only exercise a count offered by this model; the model/ratio/count checks may share one generation when all outcomes are observed separately.

cases.title: Stop an active generation
steps: Start an approved generation and use stop while it is active.
Inspect the board and composer after cancellation.
cases.expected: The generation stops and another request can be entered; cancellation may discard its receipt.

cases.title: Generate after stopping
steps: After stopping, send one new approved generation request.
Open its result.
cases.expected: Generation can start again and produces a readable image; if the previous board had no surviving generation, a new board may be created.

cases.title: Retry a failed generation receipt
steps: Use retry on a real failed receipt that offers it, within the caller's model-call allowance.
Inspect the retry outcome.
cases.expected: Retry submits successfully and produces a readable result.
cases.condition: Requires a naturally occurring or caller-provided disposable failed receipt. Do not induce failure or repeatedly pay for generation to obtain a passing result; otherwise record incomplete.

cases.title: Rename a board
steps: Rename a run-created board from its offered action.
Leave and reopen the gallery entry.
cases.expected: The new board name remains visible.

cases.title: Reopen a board
steps: Leave the run-created board.
Open it again from the gallery and inspect a recent image.
cases.expected: The expected board and its images are available.

cases.title: Inspect generation information
steps: Open generation information for a run-created image.
Read its model and prompt information, then dismiss it.
cases.expected: Information corresponding to that generation appears and the image remains usable.

cases.title: Delete an image version
steps: Delete a disposable run-created version while retaining another version.
Inspect the surviving board.
cases.expected: The selected version is removed and focus/navigation reaches a surviving version.

cases.title: Save an image locally
steps: Save a generated image to the caller-approved local destination.
Confirm the saved image is accessible there.
cases.expected: A readable saved image is accessible at the chosen destination.

cases.title: Crop and save a local image
steps: Open a caller-approved editable image through the library or composer.
Make an obvious crop, save and inspect the result.
cases.expected: The cropped result is visible; the source remains intact and the library/composer points to the appropriate edited result.

cases.title: Rotate and save a local image
steps: Open a caller-approved editable image and rotate it once.
Save and inspect the result.
cases.expected: The rotated result is visible and the source remains intact.

cases.title: Cancel a local image edit
steps: Open an editable image, change its crop or rotation, then cancel.
Inspect the original view.
cases.expected: The unsaved adjustment is discarded and the original image remains accessible.

cases.title: Preview JPEG
steps: Open the caller-selected known-good JPEG sample from the library.
Display the recognizable image; zoom/pan where supported, then return.
cases.expected: The expected content and basic viewer interaction work, and the app remains usable after returning.
cases.condition: Use the JPEG sample specified by the caller. Record the actual MIME type and viewing path; host-file presence alone does not prove on-device availability.

cases.title: Open a sent chat attachment
steps: Open one caller-approved sent attachment from a conversation.
Inspect recognizable content and return to that conversation.
cases.expected: The preview works from the message entry and the same conversation remains usable.

cases.title: Open an assistant-produced file
steps: Open one accessible assistant-produced file from its message.
Inspect recognizable content and return.
cases.expected: The file opens from its assistant message and the conversation remains usable.

cases.title: Edit and save a test provider
steps: Open the dedicated test provider and record the original non-secret values.
Change a caller-approved reversible field, save, reopen, then restore it.
cases.expected: The changed value persists and the original configuration is restored.

cases.title: Load a provider's models
steps: Open the dedicated provider's model-management entry.
Use its offered model-list loading action.
cases.expected: A usable model list appears and settings remain navigable.
cases.condition: Only use an offered model-list action; lack of provider support is reported as incomplete.

cases.title: Add a test model
steps: Add the caller-specified valid model to the dedicated test provider.
Save and reopen its model list; remove only the run-created entry after dependent checks.
cases.expected: The added model is visible with the selected identifier and settings.

cases.title: Toggle provider enablement
steps: Record the test provider's enabled state.
Toggle it, leave and return, then restore the original state.
cases.expected: The selected state persists and the provider is restored for other checks.

cases.title: Change the default chat model
steps: Record the original default chat model and select an approved replacement.
Enter the feature that consumes this default and send a short question, then restore the default.
cases.expected: The relevant new/default-model flow uses the selected model and receives a reply.

cases.title: Change the default image model
steps: Record the original default image model and select an approved replacement.
Enter the relevant default-model generation flow and generate once, then restore the default.
cases.expected: The flow uses the selected image model and produces a readable result.

cases.title: Change the theme
steps: Record the current theme, choose another offered theme and visit chat.
Reopen the setting and restore it.
cases.expected: The selection is retained, the visible theme changes and normal navigation works.

cases.title: Change the language
steps: Record the current language and choose another supported language.
Visit a main screen, then restore the original language.
cases.expected: Visible interface copy follows the chosen language and can be restored.

cases.title: Change the font size
steps: Record the current font size and change it.
Inspect chat text, reopen the setting and restore it.
cases.expected: Text size visibly changes, the setting is retained and essential controls stay usable.

cases.title: Change the share-watermark setting
steps: Record the share-watermark value, change it, save if required and reopen the setting.
Restore its original value.
cases.expected: The changed value is retained and restored; this case does not claim that an exported image was checked.

cases.title: Change the test profile name
steps: Record the test profile name, change it to a run-labelled value and save.
Reopen the profile and restore the original name.
cases.expected: The saved name is visible and can be restored.

cases.title: Change the test profile avatar
steps: Record how to restore the current test avatar, then select the approved image and save.
Inspect the updated profile and restore the prior avatar.
cases.expected: The selected avatar appears and the prior state can be restored.
cases.condition: If the current avatar cannot be restored, ask for a disposable test profile before modifying it.

cases.title: Operate a notification control
steps: Record an available notification toggle's value.
Change it, leave and return, then restore it.
cases.expected: The offered control responds and its state is visible after returning.
cases.condition: Use the control available on this platform; do not send a notification as an extra test.

cases.title: Open permission details
steps: Open an available permission-detail entry from settings.
Inspect its state and return.
cases.expected: The permission detail is accessible and app navigation resumes.

cases.title: Return from system settings
steps: Use an offered permission/system-settings link.
Return to the selected app without changing unrelated system configuration.
cases.expected: The intended system page opens and the app remains usable after returning.

cases.title: Operate a reversible privacy control
steps: Record the selected privacy setting, change it, leave and return.
Restore the initial value.
cases.expected: The control's saved value changes and is restored without submitting diagnostics.

cases.title: Open data and storage settings
steps: Open the available data/storage settings page.
Inspect its displayed state and return.
cases.expected: The page is usable; no backup restore, clearing or migration is claimed.

cases.title: Open About
steps: Open About and inspect the displayed app information.
Return to settings.
cases.expected: App information is visible and return navigation works.

cases.title: Open a non-destructive settings dialog
steps: Open an offered informational dialog, such as license or storage details.
Dismiss it and continue navigating.
cases.expected: The dialog opens and closes without leaving an unusable overlay.
cases.condition: Do not use a destructive action or trigger an update download to manufacture this case.
